A digital 3D rendering with a painterly yet sharp focus depicts a futuristic, anime-inspired male figure with bright, slightly desaturated blue spiky hair and fair skin tone. He is wearing two-toned rectangular glasses, with the left lens being bright, slightly desaturated orange and the right lens being bright, slightly desaturated blue, and glowing bright, slightly desaturated blue light emanates from beneath them. His face is angular, with defined cheekbones and a neutral expression. A light bright, slightly desaturated blue scarf is draped around his neck.

The figure's body is a complex, partially exposed robotic structure. Bright, slightly desaturated white and darker metallic grey armored plates with visible wear and rust cover parts of his torso, arms, and legs, revealing intricate networks of darker metallic wires, tubes, and mechanical components beneath. Bright, slightly desaturated blue glowing lights are integrated into various parts of the robotic structure.

Two large, futuristic weapons with darker metallic textures, vents, and targeting scopes are mounted on his back.

Behind the figure and slightly to the right is a bright, slightly desaturated blue square sign with the stylized bright, slightly desaturated white letters "in." followed by a bright, slightly desaturated white dot. The sign is attached to a silver pole. The background is a bright, slightly desaturated white. Soft and somewhat diffused lighting creates subtle highlights and shadows.
